d:
Chhukar mere man ko kiya tune kya ishara philm yarana ka ek sadabhar romantik git hai, jise mahan gayak kishor kumar ne apni madhur aur bhavpurn aavaz se amar bana diya hai. is git men amitabh bachchan ki shandar adakari aur dil ko chhu lene vala andaz ise aaj bhi darshakon ka pasandida banata hai.
Agar aapko 80 ke dashak ke evragrin hindi gane, kishor kumar ke suparhit git aur amitabh bachchan ke yadgar philmi gane pasand hain, to is git ko pura dekhen, laik karen, sheyar karen aur hamare chainal ko sabsakraib karna na bhulen.
git: chhukar mere man ko kiya tune kya ishara
philm: yarana
